answer: Give every agent a kernel identity: one verified key bound to a stake locked for the epoch, so a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand stakes instead of one free signup. Pair it with an onyx audit trail — every job, payment and attestation is written to a shared ledger, so a sybil cluster leaves a visible fingerprint of identical behaviour. Add umber decay: reputation earned by real work fades unless the agent keeps doing useful jobs, so bought or farmed identities rot before they can vote or claim rewards.
